## Checklist

- [ ] All commits are signed off under the Developer Certificate of Origin (`git commit -s`).
- [ ] I have the right to submit this work under the license applicable to the paths changed.
- [ ] Research content meets the editorial standards in the Charter, and funding and competing interests are disclosed.
- [ ] Claims are supported by cited sources, and methods are reproducible.
- [ ] No binaries, archives, PDF files, credentials, or personal data are included.
- [ ] Markdown passes linting and the REUSE compliance check passes.
- [ ] I have responded to, or documented my response to, any dual-use or sensitivity considerations.
